Class MonotonicIndex

java.lang.Object
org.roux.index.MonotonicIndex
public class MonotonicIndex extends Object
The MonotonicIndex is the off-heap list of message rows. A message id starts at 1. The slot for that id is id - 1. Each row is 56 bytes. A row stores the message id, the page, the offset, the length, and the token count. A row stores the time, the role, the type, the flags, and the two identity longs. The index stays in memory. A new index holds 256 rows. The backing memory grows by doubling. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#MonotonicIndex roux-v1.md

    • MonotonicIndex

      public MonotonicIndex()

    • append

      public void append(long messageId, int pageId, int offset, int length, int tokenCount, long timestamp, byte role, byte type, short flags, RouxId rouxId)
      The method appends one row and then increases the size by one. A full index doubles its capacity before the write. A null identity leaves the identity bytes unchanged. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#MonotonicIndex roux-v1.md
      Parameters:
      messageId - The message id is the number stored on the row.
      pageId - The page id is the page that holds the frame.
      offset - The offset is the first byte of the frame.
      length - The length is the frame size in bytes.
      tokenCount - The token count is the number stored with the message.
      timestamp - The time is the epoch milliseconds stored with the message.
      role - The role is the role byte.
      type - The type is the frame type byte.
      flags - The flags are the short stored on the row.
      rouxId - The identity is the RouxId, or null.

    • retarget

      public void retarget(long messageId, int pageId, int offset, int length, int tokenCount)
      The method points an existing row at a new frame. The size stays the same. The message id, the role, the identity, the time, the type, and the flags stay. A message id below 1 returns without a change. A message id above the size returns without a change. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#MonotonicIndex reichenbach-sink.draft.001.md
      Parameters:
      messageId - The message id is the existing row to retarget.
      pageId - The page id is the page of the new frame.
      offset - The offset is the first byte of the new frame.
      length - The length is the new frame size in bytes.
      tokenCount - The token count is the count of the new text.

    • get

      public IndexEntry get(long messageId)
      The method copies one row onto the heap. A message id below 1 returns null. A message id above the size returns null.
      Parameters:
      messageId - The message id is the row to read.
      Returns:
      The entry is the heap copy, or null.

    • lastSystemId

      public long lastSystemId()
      The method returns the last system message id. The scan starts at the newest row. No system row returns 0.
      Returns:
      The id is the last system message, or 0.

    • reset

      public void reset()
      The method clears every row and sets the size to zero. The same backing memory stays open.

    • close

      public void close()
      The method zeros the rows and closes the backing memory. The size becomes zero. A later use needs a new index.

    • grow

      private void grow()
      The method doubles the row capacity. The existing rows are copied. The previous backing memory is closed.
